title: Ya Rab Koi Masooma
body:
ya rabb koi masooma
(Ya Hussain) x6
<<MINI>>
Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho (x2)
Paband naho aahei'n, haye paband naho aahei'n
Rone pe na pehra ho
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Thi jis ko nind ati, shabbir ke sine par (x2)
zindaa dare zindaa, haye zindaa dare zindaa
uske liye kazaa ho
<<MINI>>
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaano se ati thi awaaz sisakne ki (x2)
<<MINI>>
jese ke sakina ko, haye jese ke sakina ko
har zindaan ro raha ho
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho (x2)
Paband naho aahei'n, haye paband naho aahei'n
Rone pe na pehra ho
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Takraye na wo kyu kar zindaa'n ki diwaaro se (x2)
bhayi se aur phuphi se, haye bhayi se aur phuphi se
jisko juda kiya ho
<<MINI>>
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaano se ati thi awaaz sisaknene ki (x2)
<<MINI>>
jese ke sakina ko, haye jese ke sakina ko
har zindaan ro raha ho
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaan me aye *NAJAFI* yaad ayi sakina ki (x2)
dil roro keh raha hai, haye dil roro keh raha hai
ab na ujaala ho
<<MINI>>
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho (x2)
Paband naho aahi, haye paband naho aahi
Rone pe na pehra ho
(Ya rab koyi masuma zindaa me na tanhaa ho) x3
